summary: Perion Network Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, furnishing a press release about the launch of 'Ask Perion,' an agentic self-serve mobile app within the Perion One platform. The announcement describes a product rollout, not a special situation. No transactions, stakes, premiums, or structural changes are involved. The filing is a routine current report of a foreign private issuer disclosing a new product launch for digital advertising efficiency. There are no deal terms or advisory roles to note. This is a standard operational update with no special-situation characteristics.
